title: release r19: inversion batch 2 — 706 hazards from regulation-driven pipeline
head: data-verify-batch-003
body:
## Summary

- Inversion batch 2 via generator --auto mode: 54 hazards generated from remaining verified GB/T 47236-2026 clauses (atomic obligation-sentence inversion, human title review, 7 duplicates blocked by dedup).
- Real-time gate: eligibleHazards 652 -> 706, eligibleLinks 830 -> 884, strictBlockers=0.
- r19 live: 706 hazards / 173 laws / 238 clauses / 884 links, releaseHash d309c52e….
- Remaining: ~8 clauses need manual multi-obligation splitting; other laws need clause extraction before inversion.
